title: THE JUICY LASTING TINT
description:
A juicy, glossy lip tint that achieves double-glazed, high-shine gloss.

Product Description:

  • High-shine, glassy finish inspired by tanghulu (candied fruit)
  • Juicy shades inspired by fresh seasonal fruits
  • New shades created by blending fan-favorite colors from the original Juicy Lasting Tint
  • Long-lasting color and gloss that stay vibrant
  • Wide shade range designed to flatter all skin tones

Product Details:

  • Feels Like | Lightweight, non-sticky texture that leaves tanghulu-like shine on the lips

Application Tips:

  • Apply starting from the inner part of your lips
  • Blend outward to your desired intensity
  • Lightly blend to enhance and speed up the glossy glow
